name: The Cup of Súbadim the Sorcerer

system.description:
Pours a stream of any liquid the user wishes (water, oil, flammable chemicals, acid) to a range of 1"; one melee round per charge.

Charges: roll d100 when found.

How many exist: one. Never for sale, though one may sometimes be borrowed from a temple or the Imperium for a mission.
